evidence.locator: Fred's message "Heard you whooped those twin freaks asses". In mq025_02_kabuki.questphase the message is Active only after the quest journal succeeds, and that quest succeeds only after the win_fights counter incremented from the post-fight 02_talk objective (scene mq025_02_after_out).
mq025_02_kabuki: win_fights counter node increments only from 02_talk after the post-fight scene; the Fred message node is activated after the quest journal succeeds on that route.

Fred's message "Word on the street's that Buck needs some new teeth... Nicely done, V". In mq025_03_arroyo.questphase it is activated only after the quest succeeds from the win_fights counter, which is fed by 03_talk succeeded after the post-fight scene (mq025_03_after_out). The separate 03b message has a second non-combat route and is not used.
mq025_03_arroyo: 03_talk succeeds after the post-fight scene, increments win_fights, the quest succeeds, and only then is the "arroyo_won" message activated.

Fred's generic Glen result message ("you stood your ground"). Activated in mq025_05_glen.questphase after the quest journal succeeded from the win_fights counter, on the branch where money was not left to Cesar.
Fred's Glen message "Word is you realigned Cesar's face but let him keep the money". Same post-win route in mq025_05_glen.questphase, activated when mq025_05_gave_money > 0 and mq025_cash == 0.
mq025_05_glen: both Fred messages are reached only after the quest succeeds from the win_fights counter (05_talk succeeded after the fight).

Fred's message "YOU BEAT RHINO!?!?". Activated in mq025_07_fight_club.questphase after the quest succeeded from the win_fights counter, which follows 07_talk succeeded in the post-bout scene (mq025_07_after_out).

Fred's message "Heard things got ugly at the Animals joint?". Activated only in the alternate combat phase of mq025_07_fight_club.questphase, after mq025_rhino_dead is incremented; that phase forces 07_talk/07_club_fight inactive and completes 07_fight/win_fights without the sanctioned bout.
mq025_07_fight_club: after the bout scene, 07_talk succeeds, win_fights increments, the quest succeeds and the congratulation message is activated.

mq025_07_fight_club alternate combat phase (nodes/4): Rhino-dead counter, then the "things got ugly" message; the phase sets the sanctioned objectives inactive and succeeds 07_fight and win_fights directly.
Objective "Talk to Viktor" in the Razor finale; node 708 sets it Succeeded only from AndNode 317 whose input is section 736 where Viktor gives the abdominal-weakness advice.
mq025_08_finale scene: section 736 (Viktor's advice) feeds AndNode 317 which feeds the Succeeded input of the "Talk to Viktor" journal node 708.

mq025_08_finale: IF mq025_offer_yes (377/471) routes to Fred's "Nice work. It looked natural" (381) and Viktor's "You threw the fight" (473); the failed fight_mrellis objective confirms V actually lost.
Fred's mq306_hook message 01a_job: asks V to talk to his friend Aaron. Activated from the condition tree in mq306_01_intro.questphase.
Fred's mq306_hook message 01b_job: asks V to talk to his friend Aaron. Activated from the condition tree in mq306_01_intro.questphase.
Fred's mq306_hook message 01c_job: asks V to talk to his friend Aaron. Activated from the condition tree in mq306_01_intro.questphase.
Fred's mq306_hook message 01d_job: asks V to talk to his friend Aaron. Activated from the condition tree in mq306_01_intro.questphase.
mq306_01_intro.questphase: the four hook messages (01a-01d) are the only Fred job messages for this quest and are activated from one condition tree; each is Fred asking V to help Aaron.
Fred's message "Shame what happened to Aaron, but the boy knew the risk... Thank you for trying, V." Activated in mq306_04a_aaron_meeting.questphase on the route where mq306_animals_dead > 0.
Fred's message "shame a gifted boy will waste away with the Animals. Was hoping he can be helped". Activated in mq306_04b_angie_meeting.questphase right after the Angie meeting scene ends.
mq306_04a_aaron_meeting: the "aaron_dead" message follows a condition on mq306_animals_dead > 0 and a trigger; the message text itself is Fred's report that Aaron came to grief.
mq306_04b_angie_meeting: the message node is activated after the Angie meeting scene End, i.e. only on the Angie-meeting branch.

Objective "Place the deck on Nix's desk": node 389 is set Succeeded only after the [Set down deck] choice (69) and the item removal (276) in the Afterlife scene, following Nix's line "Put the deck on the counter".
mq016_02_afterlife scene: Nix asks V to put the deck on the counter (934), V picks [Set down deck] (69), the deck item is removed (276) and only then is 03_give_nix Succeeded (389).
Nix's own message "V, let's meet. It's about you know what..." (conversation titled "I've got the thing we talked about"), activated in q305_01_task after V's wait for Nix.
Objective "Talk to Nix" succeeded when the Nix meeting phase completes at the Arasaka Memorial, after the q305_02b_nix scene in which Nix hands over the convoy data.

q305_02b_nix scene: V asks "Got the data?" and Nix lists itinerary, convoy vehicle order, defenses and the detainee details (section 58); talk_nix is Succeeded by the Nix meeting phase after that scene.

Objective "Stop in front of the ripperdoc clinic": succeeded in mq012.questphase only when the clinic trigger area is reached with the vehicle slowed; the failure branch (condition 285) goes to the dead-passenger route only while this objective is not succeeded.
Objective "Keep busy while waiting for a call from the distressed man": succeeded later once the content token fires, i.e. the passenger was delivered and is being treated.
mq012.questphase: 04_stop_at_ripper succeeds on trigger-area + vehicle speed at the clinic, which activates 05_wait_for_call and the at-ripperdoc scene.
Objective "Shoot the targets" in Wilson's range contest: node 538 is Succeeded after the shooting-over fact is set at the end of the round timer (540/545).
mq011_00_gun_range scene: 00_shoot is succeeded only after mq011_shooting_over is set once the shooting round ends.
Objective "Talk to Ozob" is succeeded from the closing scene in mq035_04_ambush.questphase, after the ambush combat objective (06_kill_enemies) succeeded.
mq035_04_ambush: 07_talk_ozob is succeeded by the ending scene that follows the combat objective 06_kill_enemies.

Objective "Defeat the gangoons": succeeded in mq040_bar_fight.questphase once the two Valentino aggressors are killed, defeated or unconscious. The intimidation route never activates it (save D lacks it).
mq040_bar_fight: 02_fight is activated from the intervene-decision node and succeeded after the combat; it is distinct from the non-combat route.

Objective "Go to the area where Pepe's wife works during the day": the trail phase is entered only after V agrees to Pepe's request ("Sure, I'm in" in mq040_01_bar.scene) and this node is succeeded when the arrival scene exits.
mq040_trail_wife: the whole trail phase starts only after the agreement scene; 03a_go_to_trail_location is succeeded by the arrival scene exit.

Objective "Sit with Kirk": succeeded only at the [Sit] "Heard about you and Pepe" choice (458), which in the Meet_Your_Fixer scene always comes after Pepe's request at the bar (choice 402 "I'll talk to Kirk").
q000_kid_01b_meet_your_fixer: from the main entry, V's agreement to talk to Kirk (402/404) dominates the sit-down with Kirk (458 -> 799 Succeeded); Pepe's lines in 433 state the debt.

Objective "Talk to Jackie" (talk_jackie_person) succeeded at node 981 after V's ride line (975); every route from the scene entry to it passes through Jackie's job pitch (section 1068, or its twin 1668).
q001_03a_meet_jackie_downstairs: all paths from entry q001_jackie_mb_in to talk_jackie_person Succeeded (981) include Jackie's Dexter DeShawn pitch (1068/1668).

sq018_03a_misty scene: V's offer to Misty (choice 231 "You really oughta come") ends with "I guess you're right. Thanks, V." and then sets sq018_03a_misty_invited. An extra writer exists in the standalone tarot quest (debug), so the rule also requires the ceremony objective.
sq018_03_funeral.questphase: IF sq018_03a_misty_invited > 0 routes True to Misty's "chat_on_the_way" and "after_ofrenda" scene sections (actors Misty and Mama Welles), False to "misty_stayed".
Mama Welles' message "I found something that belonged to Jackie... It's waiting in front of your apartment" (package-only branch of Heroes).
Objective "Collect the package from Mama Welles", succeeded once the package is in the inventory on that branch.
sq018_00_holocall.questphase: the package message leads to 03_get_package Active and Succeeded on an inventory check; this is the alternative to the Mama Welles conversation route.
Delamain's message that Jackie's body was delivered to Viktor Vektor's clinic, activated in q101_p2_v_room.questphase only when q005_14_body_at_victors >= 1 (and not the family route).

Delamain's clinic message needs q005_14_body_at_victors; Viktor's default dialogue unlocks "Did you take care of Jackie's body?" on that same fact and he recounts Arasaka coming in and putting him face down (section 56).
Viktor's reply message in Dazed and Confused: treatment is psychotherapy, expose the patient to something personal from their true reality; patients are suggestible.
mq303_messages.questphase: Viktor's reply node is activated in the message sequence after V sends the question; the text states the advice.
q307_03a_friends_holocall: the fact is set (646) only after Viktor's closing line "I'll see you, V. You know the address." (section 259) and the holocall-end flag.
q307_03a_friends_holocall: Viktor's last line (259) feeds the holocall-end flag, which feeds the only writer of q307_call_viktor_end.

Objective "Talk to Misty": in the first-mural scene node 486 is Succeeded only after Misty's section 39 ("Look for more images... I'll help you decipher what you've seen") when fewer than 20 murals are found.
mq033_1_first_grafitti: Misty's reply (section 39) feeds the counter check (513) whose false branch Succeeds 01_talk_to_misty (486).
Optional objective "Talk to Viktor": succeeded at node 490 directly after section 20 in which V describes the murals to Viktor.
mq033_1_first_grafitti: section 20 (V and Viktor on the murals) is the only input of the Succeeded socket of 01_talk_to_victor (490).
Objective "Talk to Misty" (after all 20 murals): succeeded at node 69 in the final reading scene, directly after Misty's parting section (83) that follows the [Take] choice.
mq033_2_all_grafitti: 03_talk_to_misty is succeeded (69) from section 83 after the [Take] choice (84), which also adds the dreamcatcher item (94) and marks the quest complete (70).
mq033_2_all_grafitti: the [Take] choice (84) leads to section 83 which both succeeds 03_talk_to_misty (69) and runs the add-item node (94) for Items.mq033_dreamcatcher.

Objective "Ask Misty about the new tarot cards you found": activated only after all four King murals are scanned, succeeded by the scene exit "fortune told" or return_from_ep1_tarot; both are set only after Misty's final four-card reading in mq033_ep1_grafitti.

mq033_ep1_grafitti: the "What's my choice here" option is gated by four_kings_gathered; it leads to the final reading (449), then choice 435 and the fortune-told exit; return_from_ep1_tarot is also set only on that chain.

Objective "Talk to Viktor" in Nocturne Op55N1: node 2401 is Succeeded only from AndNode 3336, which waits for the end of Viktor's closing instructions (sections 2090 / 1325 / 3314 / 3317) after his warning and treatment.

q115_02_ripperdoc scene: V's arrival and treatment (1332; 1181 "Try sitting up. Carefully."), Viktor's warning (1206: "Next attack... you'll flatline in some back alley") and instructions (1325, or 2090 in the Rogue-lover variant) lie on every path to AndNode 3336, the sole input of the Succeeded socket for 00_talk_johnny (2401).
Objective "Follow Misty" on the way to the clinic roof; Succeeded at node 1685 -> 1040 when V reaches the roof.
Objective "Sit by Misty" on the roof; Succeeded at node 553 once V sits.

q115_02b_ripperdoc_roof scene: Misty offers to show V her spot (17), says "I come here when I need to get away, be alone with my thoughts" (75); the follow and sit objectives are then succeeded (1040, 553).
Objective "Talk to Hellman and Takemura" at Misty's Esoterica; Succeeded (614) after V's conversation with Anders Hellman, on the Hanako route only.
Objective "Talk to Hellman" (Takemura-dead variant) at Misty's Esoterica; Succeeded (615) after the Hellman conversation, Hanako route only.
Objective "Talk to Panam" at Misty's Esoterica; Succeeded (583) from section 391 where Panam arrives and Misty says "Look out for yourself, V", Panam route only.

q115_02d_misty: every route to the Hellman conversation objectives (614/615) passes Misty's "is that... an Arasaka stretch? They killed Jackie!" section (283/1143) and the exchange that follows (288).
q115_02d_misty: 12c_talk_panam is succeeded (583) from section 391 (Panam: "Come on. Everybody's waiting at camp." / Misty: "Look out for yourself, V.").
Objective "Talk to Viktor" in Playing for Time: succeeded in q101_p1_b_vic_garage.questphase only after the scene exit garage2_out; every route to that exit passes Viktor's diagnosis section 1268.

q101_07_ripperdoc scene: every option of choice 1331 leads to section 1268 (the diagnosis), which lies on every path to exit garage2_out; the vic_garage phase succeeds the Viktor objective from that exit.

Objective "Take the pills": Succeeded when V picks [Take meds] (1259) in V's apartment, which is entered only after Misty's home visit part of the same scene has finished (misty_goto_sleep_out feeds the Johnny part of the V-room phase).

q101_07c_johnny_triggers: Misty explains the meds (656) and returns the charm (600) in the misty_goto_sleep part; the q101_p2_v_room phase starts the Johnny part (where eat_pills is succeeded via 1259) only after misty_goto_sleep_out.
Objective "Sit in the ripper's chair": Succeeded (1591) when V accepts Viktor's examination (hub 1597).
Objective "Leave Viktor's clinic": activated (1224) after the clinic conversation ends.

rules.statement: V beat the Kabuki twins in the Beat on the Brat fight; Fred texted afterwards that he had heard V whooped the twin freaks.
V beat Buck in the Arroyo Beat on the Brat fight; Fred texted that word on the street was that Buck needed new teeth.
V beat Cesar in the Glen Beat on the Brat fight; Fred texted about it (one variant adds that Cesar was allowed to keep his money).
V beat Rhino in the sanctioned Beat on the Brat bout at the Animals' club; Fred texted congratulations.
The Rancho Coronado Beat on the Brat qualifier was closed through open combat at the Animals' club rather than the sanctioned bout; Fred texted that he heard things got ugly there.
Before the Razor Hughes finale Viktor told V that Razor had a weakness: abdominal muscles that had been swapped out, so V should hit him there.
V accepted Fred's offer to throw the Razor Hughes finale and then lost it; afterwards Fred said the loss looked natural and Viktor said V had thrown the fight.
Fred sent V a message asking her/him to talk to his boxer friend Aaron and help him (No Easy Way Out).
After V's attempt to help Aaron, Fred texted that it was a shame what happened to Aaron but he knew the risk; this is the game's Aaron-dead variant of Fred's report and he thanks V for trying.
After V's dealings with Angie, Fred texted that he did not know exactly what happened but Aaron would waste away with the Animals; he had hoped Aaron could be helped.
V put the recovered Kold Mirage deck down on Nix's counter at the Afterlife so that he could begin decrypting it.
Nix messaged that he had what V asked for, then met V at the Arasaka Memorial and handed over the convoy data: itinerary, vehicle order, defenses and the detainee's details.
V drove the distressed Jesse to the ripperdoc clinic and he arrived alive; V then waited for his call (Burning Desire).
V took part in Robert Wilson's shooting contest at the gun range (Shoot to Thrill) and shot through the round.
V drove Ozob Bozo to his destination, fought off the ambush on the way and finished the job by talking to Ozob afterwards (Send in the Clowns).
When two Valentino thugs threatened Pepe at the bar, V fought and beat them rather than talking them down.
Pepe hired V to follow his wife and check his suspicions, and V began the investigation by going to the area where she works.
At El Coyote Cojo Pepe told V he owed Kirk Sawyer money and was afraid of what Kirk would do; V agreed to talk to Kirk on his behalf.
Over noodles at the megabuilding, Jackie told V he had landed them a job fronted by the fixer Dexter DeShawn, arranged through T-Bug, and that Dex wanted to meet V face to face.
V invited Misty to Jackie's ofrenda; she came, rode with V to the ceremony and was with Mama Welles and V at the ofrenda.
Instead of the full ofrenda route, Mama Welles messaged V that she had found something that belonged to Jackie and left it for V in front of V's apartment, and V collected the package.
V had Jackie's body taken to Viktor's clinic; Arasaka agents then seized it there, forcing Viktor to the floor.

When V messaged Viktor about the identity problem, he replied that psychotherapy works best and the key is exposing the patient to something personal from their true reality; he also warned the patient is highly suggestible.
In 2079, after waking from the coma, V called Viktor; he ended the call by saying he would see V at his clinic, "You know the address".
After spotting the first strange tarot mural, V showed Misty the scan; she said it was a major arcanum sign from a higher power and told V to keep looking for more images.
V told Viktor about the strange murals they kept seeing; he said it was probably the biochip overloading the brain and that the only fix was to get rid of the chip.
After finding all twenty city murals V returned to Misty, who told V the tarot said V would reach the World by one of four paths: the Sun, the Star, Temperance or the Devil.
At the end of that final tarot reading Misty gave V a dreamcatcher ("Take this. It's all I can do to help") and wished V luck on whatever road V chose.

After finding all four King murals in Dogtown, V went to Misty and asked what the four Kings meant; she said V was caught between strong, warring personalities who all wanted to influence V, and that V's fate was still V's to shape.

Viktor treated V at the clinic after V dragged in beaten and half-conscious, warned that V had reached a critical juncture and would flatline in some back alley after the next attack, and told V to take matters into his own hands.
After Viktor's ultimatum, Misty led V up to the clinic rooftop where she goes to be alone with her thoughts, and V sat down beside her to think.

When an Arasaka car arrived for V outside Misty's Esoterica, Misty recognised the stretch, objected that Arasaka had killed Jackie, and called V's decision to work with them a betrayal; V then left with Hellman and Takemura.
While V waited at Misty's Esoterica, Panam's car arrived for V; Misty saw it come and said goodbye as Panam took V to the Aldecaldo camp.
After the Heist, Viktor told V that the biochip was a bomb with the fuse lit, that Silverhand's construct was overwriting V's consciousness, and that V had only a few weeks.

Misty took V home after Viktor's clinic and explained the medicines: omega blockers to slow the Relic and keep Johnny quiet, and her own pseudoendotrizine to speed things up; she gave V a lucky charm Viktor pulled out of V's skull and urged V to sleep, and V took the pills.
In 2079 Viktor scanned V in his clinic and found that V's cortex had turned deaf to implant signals; he could find no safe fix and admitted he had been wrong to promise one.

In 2079 Misty found V hurt in the alley, talked with V while her ride was on its way, and V walked her to it; she said "So, till we meet again, I guess" and that the pendant she once gave V no longer mattered.
